units.source_text: 源氏公子依依不舍，哀声哭道：“我跟父皇同去！”

en.t: Prince Genji could not bear to part from him, and cried out in a sorrowful voice, "I will go with my father!"

units.source_text: 抬头一看，不见人影，只有一轮明月照耀天空。

en.t: When he raised his head and looked, there was no one there; only a bright full moon shone in the sky.

units.source_text: 并不像是做梦，但觉父皇面影隐约在目，天空飘曳的云彩也很可亲可爱。

en.t: It did not seem like a dream, for his father's face still hovered faintly before his eyes, and even the drifting clouds in the sky seemed dear and lovely.

units.source_text: 年来渴慕慈容，却一次也不曾入梦。

en.t: For years he had longed for that gentle face, yet it had never once appeared in his dreams.

units.source_text: 今晚虽然刹那，但是分明看清，现在还闪现眼前。

en.t: Tonight, though it had lasted only an instant, he had seen it clearly, and it still flashed before his eyes.

units.source_text: 我今遭此苦厄，濒于死亡，父皇在天之灵特地飞翔到此，前来救助，令人不胜感激。

en.t: Now that I have fallen into such misery and stand on the brink of death, my father's spirit in heaven has flown here especially to save me, and I am more grateful than words can say.

units.source_text: 如此想来，倒是托这暴风雨之福。

en.t: Thinking of it this way, he felt that he had the storm to thank after all.
With hope now before him, he was filled with immeasurable joy.

units.source_text: 对父皇的恋慕之情充塞胸中，反觉心情忐忑不安。

en.t: His longing for his father filled his breast, and instead of calming him, it made his heart restless and uneasy.

units.source_text: 便忘却了现世的悲哀，而痛惜梦中不曾详细晤谈。

en.t: He forgot the sorrows of the present world and only regretted bitterly that he had not spoken with him at length in the dream.

units.source_text: 他想或许可以再见，便闭上眼睛，希望续梦。

en.t: Thinking that he might perhaps see him again, he closed his eyes and hoped the dream would continue.

units.source_text: 然而心目清醒，直到天明。

en.t: Yet his mind and eyes stayed clear and awake until dawn.
